title: Fee Waiver, Payment and Refund Terms by Visit Type (Specimen Collection Appointments)
content:
Patient Financial Services publishes the following waiver, payment and refund settings for collection-service fees on **Specimen Collection Appointments**.

| Visit type | First-occurrence courtesy waivers per rolling 365 days | Waiver request window (calendar days after assessment) | Payment methods accepted | Fee due timing | Fees paid refunded when the laboratory cancels | Refund issued within (business days) | Weather-closure fee waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 0 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | Not applicable | Yes | 5 | Yes |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | 0 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | Not applicable | Yes | 5 | Yes |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | 0 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | Not applicable | Yes | 5 | Yes |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | 0 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | Not applicable | Yes | 5 | Yes |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 0 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | Not applicable | Yes | 5 | Yes |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 1 | 30 | Credit card, debit card, HSA/FSA card | At completion | Yes | 7 | Yes |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | 0 | 30 | None (no patient-paid fees) | Not applicable | Yes | 7 | Yes |

## Settings explained

- **First-occurrence courtesy waivers** — the number of late-cancellation or no-show fees that may be waived as a first-occurrence courtesy within any rolling 365 days.
- **Waiver request window** — the calendar days after a fee was assessed within which the patient may ask for a courtesy or weather waiver.
- **Payment methods accepted** — the cards accepted for collection-service fees; an empty list means the visit type has no patient-paid fees.
- **Fee due timing** — the published timing setting for collection-service fees of the visit type: at completion of the collection, or not applicable.
- **Refunded when the laboratory cancels** — whether every fee paid on a visit the laboratory cancels is refunded.
- **Refund issued within** — the business days within which a fee refund is issued to the original payment method.
- **Weather-closure fee waiver** — whether fees arising from a weather closure day declared by the laboratory are waived.

## Points of reading

- Of the seven visit types, only the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit allows a courtesy waiver (1 per rolling 365 days); for every other type the courtesy allowance is 0.
- A refund on a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit or a Facility Bedside Collection Visit is issued within 7 business days; on the five Patient Service Center visit types within 5.
- The Facility Bedside Collection Visit accepts no payment method because it carries no patient-paid fees.
